title: .agents/state/pending-confirmation.json (files that init or update WROTE but that are not yet effective)
description: Written by /agentive:init and /agentive:update (interactive, headless and Routines runs alike; INITWRITE 2026-10-29 revised init.headless 2026-10-16: they no longer skip confirm_scope files). Each item is a file that exists but does not work yet: Claude Code in an untrusted folder under claude -p (permissions.allow and additionalDirectories are not used before trust), a Codex hooks.json whose hook hash a human has not trusted in /hooks, or a Codex .codex/ file that could not be written (workspace-write keeps an existing .codex/ read-only). Recomputed by every init and update run; the file is removed when nothing is left. The next interactive SessionStart shows a notice.

rendered_sha256.description: sha256 of the file as written (write_failed: of the content that could not be written); optional

next.description: the one action that makes the file effective
